top_signals.title: Gold Slumps on Rate Hike Outlook, AI Stocks Selloff
top_signals.summary: Gold slid below $3,500 an ounce as a selloff in stocks continued and a key inflation print reinforced bets on further Federal Reserve rate hikes. Bullion declined as much as 3.7% to $3,426.77 an ounce. A rout in gold has gathered pace recently, with the metal plunging nearly 9% last week, on track for a third straight monthly decline of more than 6%. Bloomberg's Mike McGlone joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Kazakhstan Joins Iraq in Pushing OPEC+ for a Higher Capacity Rating
top_signals.summary: Kazakhstan has joined Iraq in asking OPEC+ to raise its estimate of the country's crude production capacity, Reuters reported Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter. The request comes four days before the group meets to set its output policy for 2027. The review is OPEC's first, and will assess how much oil each member can produce sustainably, and its findings will help set production targets for next year.
